scope: One public-start chronological504000-record run of the new rolling engine, with every committed-block trace saved externally. No warmup, restored fitted anchor, truth input, retry or extension.

input.candidate_interface: Only source32, sequence and native ADC12 raw records; no archive pointer/handle or unbounded history in candidate.
input.parent_access: Byte hashing before/after; host producer alone decodes chronological records during the canonical child. No outcome scan or data-dependent calibration adjustment.

study_fixture.provenance: Explicit synthetic-study configuration, selected before archive outcomes; not user hardware specifications.
study_fixture.voltage_range_reason: Source support has |I|<=0.25, R0/Ri<=1, |vi|<=0.25, H<=0.1 and |h|<=1. With0<=SOC<=1 its conservative terminal-voltage envelope is approximately1.82..5.33 V. The broader dyadic map covers that envelope; unbounded Gaussian noise still requires explicit overflow failure.
study_fixture.quantization: Reject nonfinite/outside-calibrated-span values before rounding. For nonnegative q use floor(q+0.5), with exact half ties toward the higher code/tick. No clipping.
study_fixture.producer_domain: Ordered contiguous index;0<=actual_dt<=1 s and |I|<=0.25 A. Decode and validate engineering outputs before offering to candidate.
study_fixture.statistics: For successfully encoded records, report decoded-minus-original dt/I/V signed sum, mean, RMS, maximum absolute error, half-tie counts and channel rail counts.
study_fixture.temperature_scope: Archive contains no T; synthesized25 C only. No temperature compensation or physical ADC calibration accuracy claim.

likelihood.law: Point Gaussian voltage residual conditional on decoded current/time and quantized voltage; approximate quantized-input likelihood.
likelihood.prior: Original public supported joint mixture once in the original entering16D chart; no density Jacobian from proposal coordinates.

algorithm.initialization: re_init uses public mean and empty bank; no historical candidate input.
algorithm.flow: Offer then admit each valid record. At16 retained records call re_process(ctx,1) once. Save search stop/fraction before one postcommit re_query(ctx,0,1) at bank.estimate. Also make exactly one initial empty-block query.
algorithm.work_cap_derivation: At most11 queries/block plus initial1,10 prior evaluations/block plus initial1,16*(11 query passes+1 merge pass)*31500 attempted model steps. Rejected fractions consume finite work; counters reserve actual model calls before each recurrence.
algorithm.success_semantics: CH_OK from process means a valid merge, not convergence. Preserve unresolved stops and approximation flags.

trace.format: UTF-8 strict JSON Lines on child stdout
trace.interpretation: Original entering states and derived current states remain separately named. Approximate history/boundary flags are retained; no interval is produced.

execution.outer_output_limit_scope: Outer capture transaction enforces256 KiB live stdout. Reused supervision receives64 MiB file/combined-stream bound so inherited RLIMIT_FSIZE permits the inner trace. Outer combined stdout/stderr is additionally checked against256 KiB at closure.
execution.capture: Reuse unchanged qualified capture_preservation.py and exact wait4 streaming helper; original raw_probe.json and independent content-addressed copy must both remain intact. Never rename capture roles or silently recover an original.
execution.closure: Durable reservation before child launch. Freeze source/plan/input/binary/Python/qualification/review identities. Retain failures and partial complete trace rows. Whole-process outer wait4 includes inner supervisor, child and final inner closure; closed manifests and input/source posthashes required.
execution.failure: Stop on producer, engine, numerical, budget or integrity failure. A failed run stays failed. Missing terminal/partial activity remains explicit, never inferred zero.

publication_gate: Root publishes and verifies the reviewed source tree, then supplies the executable receipt before the single canonical invocation.

postclosure.exact_audits: Separately frozen host_audit_plan.json; no audit output enters inference.
postclosure.publication: Preserve raw JSONL and its independent exact copy locally. Package each with deterministic gzip only after closure, binding raw/compressed/decompressed hashes and sizes; compressed publication never changes the canonical capture roles or status.
postclosure.truth: Filenames may be discovered before run; contents only after candidate whole-process closure. External scoring/presentation only.
postclosure.target: Host measurements and the8680 B candidate object are not a Cortex-M23 complete SRAM/timing qualification.
